nodes.name: Pull Ticket Data
nodes.notes: Data-source pull: fetches open support tickets from the ticketing API. Configure the ticketsApi credential before activating.

nodes.name: Normalise Fields
nodes.notes: Maps the source API schema onto the pipeline schema (ticket_id, subject, description, region, channel).

nodes.name: AI Classification
nodes.notes: Custom AI prompt for analytical classification. Mirrors pipeline/prompts.yaml (classification template). Set your OpenAI credential before activating.

values.content:
=You are an analytics classifier for a customer support operation. Classify the following ticket and return ONLY valid JSON with keys: category, sentiment, priority, action_required.

Ticket ID: {{ $json.ticket_id }}
Subject: {{ $json.subject }}
Description: {{ $json.description }}
Region: {{ $json.region }}

Allowed values:
- category: billing | technical | logistics | account | feedback | unknown
- sentiment: positive | neutral | negative
- priority: low | medium | high | urgent
- action_required: true | false

Rules:
- Choose priority 'urgent' only if the customer reports a service outage or a payment was charged incorrectly.
- 'action_required' is true when the issue needs human follow-up or cannot be resolved by an automated reply.
- Return JSON only, no explanations.

nodes.name: Run Python Pipeline
nodes.notes: Executes the Python ETL on the EC2 host: extract, clean, AI-enrich and write structured CSVs. Requires the repo cloned on the host (see deploy/ec2-setup.md).

nodes.name: Log to Spreadsheet
nodes.notes: Logs the structured, AI-enriched output directly into the reporting spreadsheet. Set your Google Sheets credential and sheet ID before activating.

assignments.name: run_summary
assignments.value: =Run at {{ $now.toISO() }}: processed {{ $('Log to Spreadsheet').itemCount }} records into the structured spreadsheet.
